app.title: MediTrust
app.subtitle: Ethiopia National Medicine Patient-Safety Platform
app.tagline: Protecting patients across Ethiopia through cryptographic medicine verification and real-time recall reach.

verify.heading: Verify Medicine Pack
verify.instruction: Scan the QR code printed on your medicine pack, or type the code below.
verify.verifiedOnChain: Verified directly via Ethereum L2 RPC
verify.registeredNational: Also registered in National Medicine Registry
verify.registryUnavailable: National Registry offline — fallback verified on-chain
verify.alertMeButton: 🔔 Alert me if this medicine is recalled

recallModal.title: Recall Alert Registration
recallModal.description: Receive an immediate notification if health regulators issue a safety recall for this medicine batch.
recallModal.privacyNote: Privacy guarantee: Your contact is stored encrypted at rest, linked only to the batch (never to your pack serial or scan location), and deleted immediately upon unsubscribe (FR-RR-03, NFR-25).
recallModal.contactPlaceholder: Enter your Telegram handle or phone number
recallModal.consentCheckbox: I give explicit consent to be notified solely in the event of an official recall for batch
recallModal.successMessage: Alert active! You will be warned immediately if this batch is recalled.

bot.welcome:
🇪🇹 Welcome to MediTrust Ethiopia Medicine Verification!

Send a clear photo of your medicine pack's QR code, or paste/type the code text below (e.g. MT:1:ET-AMOX-001:SEC4491).
bot.chooseLanguage: Please select your preferred language / ቋንቋ ይምረጡ:
bot.langSetEn: Language set to English 🇬🇧. Send a photo or code anytime.
bot.langSetAm: ቋንቋ ወደ አማርኛ 🇪🇹 ተቀይሯል። የQR ኮድ ፎቶ ወይም ጽሑፍ ይላኩ።

Please retake the photo with better lighting and focus, or type the printed code directly (e.g., MT:1:ET-AMOX-001:SEC4491).
